From the owner
A kitchen island designed to do more. This custom island brings together practical storage and a clean, timeless look—with soft blue cabinetry, classic brass hardware, and a bright quartz countertop. We love details like this because a well-designed kitchen isn't just about how it looks. The right cabinetry and layout can make everyday life more functional while elevating the entire space. At Elevate Remodeling, we design and build kitchens throughout Columbus and Central Ohio with an emphasis on thoughtful design, quality craftsmanship, and lasting materials.
